description.value: Spice and Grill is an Indian restaurant in Hope, BC, offering a broad menu of South Asian classics — Butter Chicken, Tandoori specialties, biryanis, and an extensive vegetarian lineup alongside Indo-Chinese dishes and pizzas. The restaurant supports online ordering with both delivery and pickup, making it practical for cyclists who need a quick refuel or a full sit-down meal. Hope sits at the junction of the Trans-Canada and Crowsnest highways, making this a strategically placed dining stop for long-distance touring cyclists.
